Hi,

Firstly I have decided to extend your punishment an extra couple of days due to your shocking history with team griefing and rule breaking in general - as it should have been longer in the first place. Consider yourself lucky that I chose not to permanently ban you (it's Christmas anyways). Therefore your appeal will be denied.

Merry Christmas!
